content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, flagged as a watch item.","cites":["kpi:119"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:120","kpi:113"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's Core Resources income in 2024 was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.","cites":["kpi:108","kpi:114"]},{"claim":"Core Resources income from the private sector in 2024 was $724.9 million, while income from the public sector was $512.6 million and from other partners was $346.1 million.","cites":["kpi:110","kpi:109","kpi:111"]},{"claim":"Other Resources Regular made up 49% of UNICEF's total income in 2024, and Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.","cites":["kpi:115","kpi:116"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:129","kpi:130"]}]}
